B-ME is FIXED (CONFIRMED: the quoted mutant ME is red on the round's three new cases, in the mirror, and they are
green in the tree). The gates exit 0 and NEAR at the PR size is green (17 files, 104/104). But the seat's own sibling

(`cycleOf`)"; the round pins the "never the input ring" half and leaves the "edges" half unpinned.

## (3) New findings

### Blocker B-ME2 — the "cycle of EDGES" half of the held-cycle labelling is unpinned (CONFIRMED)

Mutant ME2 (`kerb.ts` `cycleOf`, :896–897): `if (path === null) cyc.push(at(a));` / `else for (let i = 0; i + 1 <
path.length; i += 1) cyc.push(at(path[i]));` → `cyc.push(at(a));` / `void path;` — each part's cycle taken as straight
chords between the vertices its input points became (`ChainInsert.placed`), the vertices the arena holds between them
on the part's row (crossings, attracted vertices, Steiner vertices) left out. The promise is stated in B-ME's own
line, C-0387 and C-0388 ("the cycle of edges carrying the part's row from `ChainInsert.placed` (`cycleOf`)") and in
`cycleOf`'s comment ("within each run, from each vertex an input point became to the next along its row's edges").

| run (mirror) | result |
| --- | --- |
| ME2 over the 17 files at 1000 | exit 0, `Test Files  17 passed (17)`, `Tests  104 passed (104)` — SURVIVES (the three B-ME cases included); `restored equal` |
| ME2 over the 17 files at 10⁴ (`PLAT_FUZZ_RUNS=10000`) | exit 0, `Tests  104 passed (104)` — SURVIVES; `restored equal` |
| the seat's outcome census (`outcome.probe.test.ts`: `fc.sample` of bfuzz's chord arbitrary, seed 20261011, 10⁴ draws; per draw every L1 kerb read (normal form and warning count), corridorUnion's L2 commit (blocks, whole, wholeBand, band in normal form) and bandUnion's L3 commit; the tree's run bit-equal on two runs, `cmp` equal) | **ME2: 201 of 10⁴ draws differ** — 17 draws' L1 kerb reads (3 reads newly EMPTY, others gaining or losing a ring), 15 corridorUnion commits, 194 bandUnion commits. (Calibration: ME on the same draws differs on 277 — 45 reads, 20 newly empty, 45 corridorUnion, 255 bandUnion.) |

Examples (chords as drawn; "tree" the found engine, "ME2" the mutant):

* **draw 1682** `[{a:15325,b:3139,hw:430,knots:[559,488],ends:'round'},{a:14782,b:0,hw:200,knots:[405,455],ends:'round'},{a:4320,b:13582,hw:236,knots:[430,199],ends:'square'}]`:
  face 0's kerb is `2702,606 0,2188 0,1233 118,1222` + `3626,0 3697,0 3622,67` in the tree and corridorUnion commits
  both as blocks (S8 ≡ S9); under ME2 the read loses the ring `3626,0 3697,0 3622,67` and the commit loses that block —
  a block the arena holds outside every band committed as band.
* **draw 3213** `[{a:2153,b:8005,hw:313,knots:[532,291],ends:'round'},{a:4624,b:50,hw:473,knots:[261,182],ends:'round'},{a:15322,b:5857,hw:14,knots:[419,141],ends:'square'}]`:
  face 0's kerb `1386,0 1623,0 1624,54 1562,40` (tree, committed as a block) → EMPTY under ME2, the block lost.
* **draw 389** `[{a:5208,b:8033,hw:10,knots:null,ends:'square'},{a:14675,b:7961,hw:481,knots:[217,486],ends:'square'}]`
  and **draw 1109** `[{a:10602,b:8022,hw:44,knots:null,ends:'square'},{a:14369,b:33,hw:7,knots:null,ends:'square'},{a:15061,b:19,hw:587,knots:[14,240],ends:'square'}]`:
  the tree reads face 3 / face 1 as EMPTY; ME2 reads `3968,3940 4000,3961 4000,4000 3967,4000` / `17,772 0,1631 0,939`,
  which corridorUnion's commit does not hold (its blocks equal the tree's) — S8 ≢ S9 under ME2.
* **draw 152**: ME2's read of face 3 gains the near-collinear ring `54,53 114,113 131,132`, which no block holds.

So ME2 changes reads and committed blocks on honest inputs of the item's own family (N-45 (a)'s silently wrong kerb,
and S8 ≢ S9) while no test of the item sees it at 10⁴. By the brief's rule a survivor on a stated promise the checker
does not find equivalent is a blocker. The tree's reading is the ruled one; the blocker is the missing pin, not the
engine.

**Required change (lane `build/M0-a-09-fix-s11` or as the session names it):** inside the item's owns, one test red
under ME2 and green on the tree, no engine change — e.g. in `dryrun.test.ts` beside the B-ME cases, the networks above

block, draw 3213 asserting face 0's kerb `1386,0 1623,0 1624,54 1562,40` and its block, and/or draw 389 / 1109
asserting the face's read is empty where the commit holds no block (S8 ≡ S9 on that face); or a hand-built case whose
part's held edge between two placed vertices runs through a vertex off the chord (an attracted or crossing vertex),
the face between the chord and the held edges labelled by the held edges. The builder's self-check re-introduces ME2

`corepack pnpm landed -- M0-a-09 --lane <lane> --wave flow-7`.
